exclusions.source_text: Adults ≥18 years of age on the day of signing the ICF.
Has ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cancer of non-epithelial origin.
Has a medical history of myocardial infarction within 6 months before randomization, symptomatic congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II to IV).
exclusions.threshold: MI within 6 months; NYHA Class II to IV

exclusions.source_text: Has a corrected QT interval prolongation to >480 msec based on average of the Screening triplicate 12-lead ECG.
